description: Two small cards, each showing a theme as a miniature preview of a browser window; click either one or move with the arrow keys and the selection ring settles on it while its label lights up.
interactionNotes: This is a radiogroup with two options: a click selects an option, and the arrows (plus Home/End) move through the options with a roving tabindex and select as they go. Hovering an unselected option shows a subtle ring, and the active option always has a ring with a bold label. Keyboard focus turns on the brand's third ring. `value` makes it controlled — `null` means nothing is selected — and `disabled` dims the whole group and makes it inert. The previews scale with container queries and stay intact at any card size.

props.themes: The theme options; each has a `value`, a label, and a six-color palette for painting the preview (sidebar/panel/border/strong/muted/tile). You can supply your own palette.
props.value: Controlled value; `undefined` means the component holds its own state, and `null` means controlled with nothing selected (for example before the theme is known on the client).
props.defaultValue: The initially selected option in uncontrolled mode; if you do not pass it, the first option is selected.
props.onChange: Called on every new selection; in controlled mode it is the only way to learn about the user's choice.
props.labels: Show the Persian label ("Dark"/"Light") under each card; the label lights up when selected.
props.disabled: Dims the whole group and makes it ignore the pointer and the keyboard (`aria-disabled` is set too).
props.itemClassName: Extra class for each option's button — for example, to change the width of the cards.
props.className: Extra class for the group container (it sits on `flex gap-5`).

tips: Besides clicking and the arrows, `Home` selects the first option and `End` the last — standard radiogroup behavior, which this component has too.
If you pass `value={null}` nothing is selected and all options stay reachable with Tab; it is made for the "the user's theme is not known yet" case.
The previews are drawn with the `cqw` unit against a container query; the bigger the card, the bigger the drawing, without stretching — for larger cards just pass `itemClassName="w-56"`.
The arrows are physical (`ArrowRight` is the next option), as per the default; the cards, however, lay out right-to-left in RTL, and the inner drawing keeps its default shape with `dir="ltr"`.
The colors inside each `ThemeOption` are drawing data and stay as hex (intentionally); the component's own frame (card surface, label ink, focus ring) reads from the site tokens.
With `prefers-reduced-motion` the transitions of the rings and labels are turned off; the selection moves instantly without motion.
